ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
መሐሉ: መሐለ — they swore (3mp perfect, G, m-ḥ-l)
መኳንንተ: መኰንን — princes, nobles (plural መኳንንት, construct 'princes of') · accusative 'princes' as object of ይፈርህ (ወይፈርህ መኳንንተ 'and he fears the princes')
ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
ለመኳንንቲሃ: መኰንን — to her nobles (ለ- 'to' + plural መኳንንት + -ሃ 'her')
በጽዮን: ጽዮን — by Zion (በ- + proper name, after ተማሕፀነ 'adjure by')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ለዳዊት: ዳዊት — to David (ለ- + proper name) · to the young prince Menelik, styled David (ንንግሮ ለዳዊት እግዚእነ 'let us tell David our lord')
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
ወመሐሉ: መሐለ — and swear! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, ወመሐሉ ሊተ) · and they swore (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ወመሐሉ ሎቱ) (G, m-ḥ-l)
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
ወመኳንንት: መኰንን — and nobles, governors (ወ- + plural መኳንንት)
ወመማክርት: መምከር — and counsellors (ወ- + plural መማክርት; the singular is not confirmed; from ምክር 'counsel')
ወመገብት: መጋቢ — and stewards (?) (ወ- + noun, plural; house reading 'stewards' ch. 29, 38–39, 43; the plural form is not as expected) (?)
ዲያቆናት: ዲያቆን — deacon (noun, plural ዲያቆናት; ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief of deacons')
ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r)
ሕገ: ሕግ — law (accusative) · construct 'law of' (ሕገ መንግሥት 'the law of kingship')
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ወበርሀ: በርሀ — and it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-r-h)
ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
በርእየ: ርእይ — at the seeing of, sight of (በ- + verbal noun of ርእየ, construct)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel') · accusative in apposition to መንታ: ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples' (the twins as heads of lines) (?) · or construct 'the two peoples of Perez and Zerah' (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ ፋሬስ ወዛራ) (?)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ኀደጉ: ኀደገ — they left (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ወአፍቀሩ: አፍቀረ — and they loved (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative)
ዘያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — who loves (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
ዘትካት: ትካት — of establishment, the established (?) (ዘ- + noun; cf. ተከለ 'plant, establish') (?) · ከመ ዘትካት 'as before, as formerly' (idiom, of the face and gaze) (?)
ወአንብዐ: አንብዕ — and tears (ወ- + noun, plural; accusative)
ተጠይሮ: ተጠይሮ — ? (?) unknown, first item in the list of hated things
ወአጣዕዎ: አጣዕዎ — and idolatry (?) (ወ- + noun, perhaps related to ጣዖት 'idol'; reading uncertain) (?)
ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ተውኔተ: ተውኔት — revelry (noun, fem.; construct 'revelry of' / accusative) (?)
አዋልደ: ወለት — daughters of (noun, plural አዋልድ, construct)
ወተፈሥሐት: ተፈሥሐ — and she rejoiced (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
አድባረ: ደብር — mountains of (plural አድባር of ደብር 'mountain', construct) · accusative 'mountains' in a list (አድባረ ወአውግረ አእባነ ወመሬተ 'mountains and hills (?), stones and earth'); construct reading also possible (?)
በጣዖት: ጣዖት — in idolatry, with idols (በ- + noun)
አእሩገ: አረጋዊ — elder, old man (plural አእሩግ (?); construct 'elders-of')
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name) · over Israel (ይነግሥ ለእስራኤል 'he shall reign over Israel') · marking the object after ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass, Israel' · ለ- marking the possessor after a noun (እከዮሙ ለእስራኤል 'their evil, (that) of Israel')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
ሠምረ: ሠምረ — he willed, was pleased (3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ኬንያሃ: ኬንያ — her craftsman, maker (noun, 'craftsman, maker' (?) as in ch. 13–16, + -ሃ '3fs her'; parallel to ወገባሪሃ) (?)
ጽርሐ: ጽርሕ — hall, chamber, inner sanctuary (construct; Budge 'fortress')
ለማኅደረ: ማኅደር — for the dwelling of (ለ- 'for' + noun, construct)
ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
ወወሀበት: ወሀበ — and she gave (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-h-b)
ንግሥተ: ንግሥት — queen (noun, fem.; construct 'queen of' before the following noun)
ለወልዳ: ወልድ — her son (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
ለደብተራሁ: ደብተራ — of his tent (ለ- genitive + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ላእከ: ላእክ — servant, minister (noun; predicate accusative with ትኩን 'that you be a servant') (?)
ለእጓለ: እጓል — to the child of (ለ- + noun, construct 'child of'; እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan')
ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
ለእሙ: እም — to his mother (ለ- + noun 'mother' + -ሁ '3ms his', giving እሙ)
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
እትለአክ: ተለአከ — I shall serve (?) (tä-stem 1cs imperf.; from ለአከ 'send', so 'be sent' is also possible) (?)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
እመሂ: እመ — whether, if (conjunction + enclitic -ሂ; እመሂ ... ወእመሂ 'whether ... or whether')
ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
ወኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at (preposition; ወ- 'and') · and where, and wherever (conjunction, ወኀበ ሖረ ይተልዎ 'and wherever he went it pursued him')
እገብር: ገብረ — I do, make (1cs imperfect, G)
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘይትዐደው: ተዐደወ — who transgresses (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
ጸልዪ: ጸለየ — pray, intercede (2fs imperative, G, ṣ-l-y)
ላዕሌየ: ላዕለ — upon me, against me (preposition ላዕለ + -የ '1cs me', ላዕሌየ)
ይትመዐዕ: ተምዕዐ — he is angry (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, m-ʿ-ʿ)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ኢያርታዕነ: አርትዐ — we did not set straight (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be straight, right')
ወኢያሠነይነ: አሠነየ — and we did not do well (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be good')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
ወኢይትፈለጥ: ተፈለጠ — and he is not parted, separated (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, Gt passive-reflexive of ፈለጠ)
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ወእምእደ: እድ — and from the hand of (ወ- + እም- + noun, construct)
ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
ወይመይጥ: ሜጠ — and he will turn (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-y-ṭ; 'turn away')
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ላዕሌነ: ላዕለ — upon us (preposition, stem ላዕሌ- + -ነ '1cp us')
ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
ገበርነ: ገብረ — we do (1cp perfect, G, after ለእመ 'if')
ንከውን: ኮነ — we shall be (1cp imperf., k-w-n)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ሀለወት: ሀለወ — she was, she was present (3fs perfect, h-l-w)
ወነዋ: ነዋ — and behold, here is (ወ- + interjection ነዋ)
ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
ዘነገረነ: ነገረ — who told us (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
ሰዶቅ: ሳዶቅ — Zadok (proper name; variant spelling of ሳዶቅ)
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
ቅብአ: ቅብእ — anointing (noun, construct 'anointing of'; verbal noun of ቀብአ)
እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ዘበሕጉ: ሕግ — what is by his law (ዘ- 'that which' + በ- 'by' + ሕግ 'law' + -ሁ 'his', contracted -ጉ)
አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
ለመንግሥት: መንግሥት — for kingship, for the kingdom (ለ- + noun)
ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king') · 'of the king', owner after an anticipating suffix (ኅይስናሁ ለንጉሥ 'the worth of the king')
ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
ሊቃውንተ: ሊቅ — chiefs, elders (plural ሊቃውንት; construct ሊቃውንተ 'chiefs of', subject here)
ወተነፍኀ: ተነፍኀ — and it was blown (ወ- + tä-stem 3ms perf. passive, n-f-ḫ)
ወቃለ: ቃል — and the word of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word of')
ዘተገብረ: ተገብረ — which was done (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ገብረ)
በአናቅጺሃ: አንቀጽ — at her doors, at its gates (በ- + plural አናቅጽ + -ሃ '3fs her/its')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
እነግረክሙ: ነገረ — I will tell you (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, n-g-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
መሰለነ: መሰለ — it seemed to us (3ms perfect, G + -ነ '1cp us')
